sentences.en: Um, he's, it's, he's an engineer.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他，它是，他是一位工程师。

sentences.en: Um, but like we, we are lived by forces that we pretend to understand, but we have to remember too, that they are lived through us.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但就像我们，我们被我们假装理解的力量所支配，但我们也必须记住，它们是通过我们来生活的。

sentences.en: You know, we are lived through them and they are lived through us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们通过它们生活，它们也通过我们生活。

sentences.en: There's an interplay that we, and we can have some awareness of that tension.
sentences.zh: 存在一种相互作用，我们可以对那种张力有一些觉察。

sentences.en: Um, and that is scary because it makes us a little bit less of an individual.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很可怕，因为它让我们作为一个个体稍微减少了一点。

sentences.en: It makes us a little bit less of a monolith or this monadic thing that is going through life, but that isn't life.
sentences.zh: 它让我们作为一个整体或这种在生活中穿行的单子式事物稍微减少了一点，但那并不是生活。

sentences.en: Um, you have archetypes within you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你内心有原型。

sentences.en: There are archetypes outside of you.
sentences.zh: 你身外也有原型。

sentences.en: We can look at how these things are knocking together,
sentences.zh: 我们可以看看这些东西是如何碰撞在一起的，

sentences.en: but that means that you have to let go of what you are right now or this thing that's completely in control because you're not.
sentences.zh: 但这意味着你必须放手你现在所是的东西，或者这个完全处于控制之中的东西，因为你并没有。

sentences.en: You know, when I was in psychotherapy, I remembered that there were all these drowning and swimming metaphors in school too.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我在接受心理治疗时，我记得学校里也有所有这些溺水和游泳的隐喻。

sentences.en: And like that, you know, just, there's a ton of like, well, you got to learn to swim.
sentences.zh: 就像那样，你知道，只是，有很多关于，嗯，你得学会游泳。

sentences.en: Sometimes the backstroke, whatever.
sentences.zh: 有时是仰泳，随便什么。

sentences.en: And you know, you're trying to do the, if you're floating on your back and the, or, you know, like, yeah, that, that protective part, it was helping you out.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你试图做，如果你仰面漂浮，或者，你知道，是的，那个保护性的部分，它曾经在帮助你。

sentences.en: And it was a stick that kept you afloat in the river.
sentences.zh: 它是一根让你在河里漂浮的棍子。

sentences.en: But now the stick is about to go over the waterfall.
sentences.zh: 但现在这根棍子快要掉下瀑布了。

sentences.en: And if you can't let it go and swim to the shore, if you keep holding on to the protective part, you know, all of that stuff.
sentences.zh: 如果你不能放手并游向岸边，如果你一直紧抓着那个保护性的部分，你知道，所有那些东西。

sentences.en: So, but maybe the sea is just too rough right now to teach patients to swim.
sentences.zh: 所以，但也许现在海面太汹涌了，无法教患者游泳。

sentences.en: Like that has changed and we can't do that.
sentences.zh: 就像那已经改变了，我们做不到那样。

sentences.en: And we need to teach patients how to sail boats, you know, Freud taking apart the whole, um, engine and trying to teach the patient how to,
sentences.zh: 我们需要教患者如何驾驶帆船，你知道，弗洛伊德拆解了整个，嗯，引擎，试图教患者如何，

sentences.en: how to be a speed boat or fix the speed boat.
sentences.zh: 如何成为一艘快艇或者修理那艘快艇。

sentences.en: Not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 那是不可能的。

sentences.en: And the sea is too rough to swim, but we can teach them to be in conversation with these forces in a way that is sustainable, like through sailing.
sentences.zh: 海面太汹涌无法游泳，但我们可以教他们以一种可持续的方式与这些力量对话，比如通过航行。

sentences.en: And maybe we can build a culture that can learn to like sail and cruise ships again, you know, um, maybe we can be in conversation with the storm, um,
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以建立一种文化，能够学会再次航行和驾驶游轮，你知道，嗯，也许我们可以与风暴对话，嗯，

sentences.en: because it's not going to go away.
sentences.zh: 因为它不会消失。

sentences.en: And if it does, it's not going to go away because of magic, because of anything we did.
sentences.zh: 如果它消失了，那也不是因为魔法，不是因为我们做了什么。

sentences.en: And it's not going to go away because of science.
sentences.zh: 而且它也不会因为科学而消失。

sentences.en: Um, we are in a storm.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们正处于一场风暴中。

sentences.en: And I think that instead of trying to swim, we need to remember to breathe and we need to remember how to use the wind.
sentences.zh: 我认为与其试图游泳，我们需要记住呼吸，我们需要记住如何利用风。
